summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become the open standard for connecting AI agents to external tools, data sources, and services via JSON-RPC, letting agents query databases, control browsers, edit code, and trigger workflows through a uniform interface. In 2026 the ecosystem spans aggregator platforms that bundle thousands of integrations, gateways that secure and route traffic, and individual high-impact servers, making MCP foundational infrastructure for agentic AI development.
ecosystem_note: Aggregators (like Composio and Smithery) bundle many MCP servers behind one managed endpoint, gateways (like agentgateway and Cloudflare) proxy, secure, and route MCP traffic, while individual servers (like Playwright or GitHub MCP) each expose one specific tool or service.

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.connects_to: Browser automation — navigate pages, fill forms, click elements, check UI state, and run end-to-end flows across browsers
strengths: Most-used MCP server in the community per mid-2026 public usage rankings
tools.best_for: Agents that need to drive real browser flows for testing or web automation

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.connects_to: GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, and code — read and edit project files, triage issues, manage PRs within scoped boundaries
strengths: Core to code-centric agent workflows in Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex
tools.best_for: Local and CI development where an agent reads and edits code safely

tools.name: Composio
tools.connects_to: Hundreds of apps (Slack, GitHub, databases, CRMs) through one managed MCP layer with a self-learning tool-selection layer
tools.pricing_paid: Usage-based paid tiers for higher volume and enterprise features
strengths: 1B+ tool calls run on the platform
Self-learning layer improves tool selection and token efficiency over time
tools.best_for: Teams wanting one managed endpoint for many integrations with reliability at scale

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: A large registry of MCP servers with one-click discovery, installation, and hosting across thousands of integrations
strengths: Largest MCP server registry for discovery
tools.best_for: Discovering and deploying individual MCP servers quickly

tools.name: Figma MCP
tools.connects_to: Figma design files — read frames, components, and design context so agents can generate code from designs
strengths: Added to the ecosystem's leading toolset in the September 2026 update
tools.best_for: Translating design files into code via AI agents

tools.name: Filesystem MCP
tools.connects_to: Local filesystem with explicit allowed directories via arguments or Roots for scoped read/write access
strengths: Explicit access control via allowed directories
Remains a default server even as fancier options emerge
tools.best_for: Local development where an agent needs scoped file access

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP
tools.connects_to: Hosted remote MCP servers with OAuth, routing, and edge deployment for MCP endpoints
tools.pricing_paid: Workers paid plans for higher usage
strengths: Deploy remote MCP servers at the edge
Eliminates local install and credential-leakage risk
tools.best_for: Hosting and securing remote MCP servers in production

tools.name: Context7 MCP
tools.connects_to: Up-to-date library and framework documentation injected into agent context on demand
tools.pricing_paid: Free; Upstash account for higher limits
strengths: Top pick across Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex
Keeps agents current on library docs
tools.best_for: Giving coding agents accurate, current documentation context

tools.name: Supabase MCP
tools.connects_to: Supabase Postgres databases, auth, and storage for querying and managing backend data
strengths: Popular in the backend developer community

tools.name: n8n MCP
tools.connects_to: n8n workflow automation — trigger and manage automations across 400+ integrated apps and services
strengths: Bridges agents to a mature workflow automation platform
tools.best_for: Connecting agents to multi-step automation workflows

tools.name: Docker MCP
tools.connects_to: Docker containers and the MCP Catalog/Toolkit for running MCP servers in isolated containers
tools.best_for: Running MCP servers securely in isolated containers

tools.name: Notion MCP
tools.connects_to: Notion workspaces — read and write pages, databases, and docs for knowledge and task management
strengths: Works across CI and remote environments
tools.best_for: Agents reading and updating team knowledge in Notion
